name: Annabeth Chase
description: Annabeth Chase is a demigod daughter of the Greek goddess Athena and girlfriend of Percy Jackson. She is one of the main protagonists in Percy Jackson and the Olympians and The Heroes of Olympus. She appears in The Staff of Serapis and meets Sadie Kane.
skills: Brilliante interllect
Unmatched tactical and strategic skills
Photographic memory
She is a master of hand-to-hand combat and survival
Architecture

name: Austin Lake
description: Austin Lake is a Greek demigod son of Apollo. He and his siblings, along with the rest of the campers, fought in the Battle of Manhattan.
skills: A world-class multi-instrumentalist (specializing in jazz saxophone) who can manipulate sound waves with music.
Can curse targets to speak exclusively in rhyming couplets for days or weeks.
Can heal physical injuries by singing ancient Greek hymns.

name: Bianca Di Angelo
description: Bianca di Angelo was a Greek demigoddess, daughter of Hades and the mortal Maria di Angelo , and older sister of Nico di Angelo . Bianca became a Hunter of Artemis in The Titan's Curse, after she and her younger brother were saved by Percy Jackson , Grover Underwood , Thalia Grace , Annabeth Chase , and the Hunters . Bianca later died on her first mission, went to Elysium, and at some point chose rebirth.
skills: The ability to instantly destroy the undead
The resistance to poisons
Perfect aim
Immortality (except in combat).

name: Charles Beckendorf
description: Charles "Charlie" Beckendorf was a Greek demigod, a son of Hephaestus. He was the head counselor of Cabin 9 at Camp Half-Blood and the boyfriend of Silena Beauregard before his death, which occurred when the Princess Andromeda blew up during a mission with Percy Jackson, shortly before the Battle of Manhattan. Beckendorf sacrificed himself in the ensuing explosion which delayed Kronos' forces and allowed Percy to escape. He was succeeded by Jake Mason, and later, Leo Valdez.
skills: Had a brilliant mechanical mind, able to build, dismantle, or repair complex machinery, traps, and automation units intuitively.
Possessed incredible upper-body strength born from working the divine forges, making him formidable in physical combat.
Like most children of Hephaestus, he had a natural high resistance to heat and burns.

name: Clarisse La Rue
description: Clarisse is the daughter of Ares and longtime head of the Ares cabin at Camp Half-Blood. Recently she went back to her home state of Arizona to attend college at ASU and terrorize all the lucky mortals there.
skills: Possesses immense superhuman strength, durability, and a natural proficiency with all types of weaponry.
Can channel her father's blessing, which temporarily grants her complete invulnerability and unmatched combat fury in battle.
An expert military leader and tactician capable of commanding armies of demigods.

name: Connor Stoll
description: Connor Stoll is a Greek demigod son of Hermes and the Head Counselor of Hermes' Cabin as his older brother Travis Stoll has left to attend college.
skills: Possess the mystical ability to lock or unlock any type of door, safe, or constraint simply by touching it.
Can move in absolute silence and steal items from right under someone's nose without being noticed.
Exceptionally manipulative, clever, and experts at setting complex pranks or traps.

name: Frank Zhang
description: Frank Zhang, also known as Fai Zhang by his Grandmother, is the Roman demigod son of Mars and Emily Zhang, as well as a legacy of Poseidon. Frank is one of the seven demigods mentioned in the Prophecy of Seven and is a Praetor of the Twelfth Legion Fulminata. He is currently in a relationship with fellow Praetor Hazel Levesque.
skills: He possesses the unique gift of metamorphosis, allowing him to transform into any animal while retaining his consciousness.
He has also inherited the “blessing of Mars,” which temporarily makes him invulnerable and a perfect warrior in battle
He is a elite archer.

name: Georgina
description: Daughter of Jo and Emmie from The Dark Prophecy, Georgina enjoys prophecies, coloring, making figurines out of pipe cleaners, and trying to ignore the fact that Apollo might be her dad.
skills: She displayed an early, dangerous affinity with the Oracle of Trophonius, making her a lightning rod for prophecy.

name: Hazel Levesque
description: Hazel Levesque is the Roman demigod daughter of Pluto and the late Marie Levesque, and the paternal half-sister of Greek demigods Bianca and Nico di Angelo. She is one of the seven heroes of the Prophecy of Seven. She is the current Praetor of Camp Jupiter following the retirement of Reyna Ramírez-Arellano, and the former Centurion of the Fifth Cohort. She is currently in a relationship with her co-praetor Frank Zhang.
skills: She has control over the earth's riches, able to summon and manipulate metals and precious stones that were originally cursed.
She is also one of the most skilled practitioners of Mist Manipulation, creating perfect illusions.

name: Jason Grace
description: Jason Grace is one of the main protagonists of the second Camp Half-Blood series, The Heroes of Olympus. He is the son of Jupiter and Ms. Grace and the younger brother of Thalia Grace. He was a praetor at Camp Jupiter until he gave his rank to Frank Zhang; he is the current counselor of Cabin One at Camp Half-Blood.
skills: Ability to shoot and channel powerful bolts of lightning.
Total control over the air, allowing him to fly on his own and create windstorms.
Roman warrior training.

name: Kayla Knowles
description: Daughter of Apollo and the Canadian archery instructor Darren Knowles, Kayla is one of the year-round campers at Camp Half-Blood, where she teaches archery classes and hopes to one day compete in the Olympics. She is a veteran of the Battle of Manhattan.
skills: A flawless marksman whose archery skills rival the Hunters of Artemis.
Possesses high physical agility and a natural talent for combat-field medicine.

name: Lavinia Asimov
description: Lavinia Asimov is a Roman demigod daughter of Terpsichore, the Muse of dance and choral songs, and Sergei Asimov. After the Battle of San Francisco Bay, she became the centurion of the Fifth Cohort. She is currently in a relationship with Poison Oak, a dryad.
skills: Has a supernatural gift for dance, specifically tap-dancing, which she uses dynamically to outmaneuver opponents.
Possesses endless physical stamina, enabling her to dance, hike, or battle undead hordes for hours without showing signs of fatigue.

name: Leo Valdez
description: Leo Valdez is the Greek demigod son of Hephaestus and the late Esperanza Valdez. He is one of the seven heroes of the Prophecy of Seven. After sacrificing himself and being resurrected using the Physician's Cure, he rescued Calypso out of Ogygia. He is currently living with Josephine and Hemithea, while going to high school with his girlfriend Calypso.
skills: He is completely immune to fire.
The capable of conjuring and shooting flames from his own hands.
He has a brilliant mechanical mind, able to build or repair any machine in seconds.

name: Lityerses
description: The son of King Midas and Demeter, Lityerses was known as the “Reaper of Men” for his skillful sword work. He has a sharp blade and a bad attitude. Then again, his dad turns him into a gold statue every time he pats Lityerses on the back, which can make someone a little cranky.
skills: Master Swordsmanship
Superhuman Physical Attributes
Agricultural Affinity
Gold Immunity

name: Luke Castellan
description: Luke Castellan is a Greek demigod son of Hermes and May Castellan. He was one of the main antagonists of the Percy Jackson and the Olympians series. He was tricked by the Titan Kronos into hosting his spirit. Although he is considered as the series’ main human antagonist, he died at age twenty-three as the hero of the Great Prophecy.
skills: Master swordsman.
Enhaced stealth skills
The ability to magically pick any lock
Great charisma
Manipulative intellect

name: Meg McCaffrey
description: Meg McCaffrey is a pint-size twelve-year-old demigod who looks like a colorfully dressed street urchin. She is fierce and bossy, and tight-lipped about her past. She may smell faintly of apple pie, but she can take down enemies with just a few pieces of rotten fruit. Also, she has a fearsome protector named Peaches.
skills: Meg can make any seed, plant, or tree grow instantly to gigantic sizes with a single command or stomp.
She can controls vines, roots, and branches to trap, suffocate, or strike enemies.
Meg can sense the health of the earth and plants and locate water sources or seeds hidden in the surrounding area.
Formidable combat agility.

name: Nico Di Angelo
description: Niccolo "Nico" di Angelo is a fourteen-year-old Greek demigod son of Hades and the mortal Maria di Angelo. He is also the younger brother of the late Bianca di Angelo and the half brother of Hazel Levesque. He is known in the Underworld as the “Ghost King” after taking the title from King Minos. He is openly gay and the boyfriend of Will Solace.
skills: A master of necrophony and necromancy, capable of summoning and controlling armies of the dead, skeletons, and ghosts.
He can travel through the shadows (teleport)
He can control the earth and black stones of the Underworld.

name: Octavian
description: Octavian was a Roman legacy of Apollo and the Augur of Camp Jupiter. He was one out of several people to have the gift of prophecy. Octavian was also a centurion in the First Cohort. During the Siege of Camp Half-Blood, he dies after accidentally shooting himself out of an onager aimed towards Leo Valdez, who was making sure Gaea was destroyed, therefore helping to defeat her.
skills: As a legacy of Apollo, he possessed a limited form of prophecy. He interpreted the future by reading omens, primarily by cutting open stuffed animals (or real sacrifices).
A master orator and hyper-charismatic speaker capable of swaying the entire Roman Senate and legion with words alone.

name: Paolo
description: Son of Hebe, Paolo hails from Brazil. He is known for his dashing good looks, his general friendliness, and his tendency to lose his limbs during combat, but don’t worry! Hebe’s children are incredibly hearty, and the Apollo cabin has some good healers.
skills: Possesses an extremely potent life force that allows him to heal from grievous wounds extraordinarily fast.
Inherits a constant feeling of youthfulness that gives him superior health, physical stamina, and energy.

name: Percy Jackson
description: Perseus "Percy" Jackson is the main protagonist and the narrator of the Percy Jackson and the Olympians series as well as one of the main characters in The Heroes of Olympus series. He is a Greek demigod son of Poseidon and Sally Jackson. He is the counselor of Poseidon’s Cabin and is a former Praetor of the Twelfth Legion at Camp Jupiter. He is currently in a relationship with Annabeth Chase.
skills: Complete control over water, including the ability to create waves and hurricanes.
Accelerated healing and increased strength when in contact with water.
He cannot drown, does not get wet unless he wants to, and can breathe underwater.
He is a master swordsman.
He can communicate with sea creatures and horses, such as Pegasus.

name: Pipe McLean
description: Piper McLean is the Greek demigod daughter of Aphrodite and Tristan McLean. She is the Head Counselor of Aphrodite's Cabin and one of the demigods of the Prophecy of Seven. She is the ex-girlfriend of the late Jason Grace and is currently in a relationship with Shel.
skills: She possesses the rare gift of Charm (Charmsspeak), a magical vocal persuasion ability that compels others to do as she asks.
She can also speak French fluently and naturally.

name: Reyna Ávila Ramírez-Arellano
description: Reyna Avila Ramírez-Arellano is a Roman demigod, the daughter of Bellona, and the younger sister of the current Queen of the Amazons, Hylla. She is a former praetor of Camp Jupiter, and is currently a Hunter of Artemis.
skills: The ability to share her own strength, courage, and speed with nearby allies during battle.
Impeccable military skills
An excellent hand-to-hand combatant.

name: Silena Beauregard
description: Silena Beauregard was a Greek demigod daughter of Aphrodite and Mr. Beauregard, the girlfriend of Charles Beckendorf, the former head counselor of the Aphrodite Cabin at Camp Half-Blood, and a spy for Kronos. She was ultimately killed by the Lydian Drakon in the Battle of Manhattan.
skills: Possessed subtle control over the emotions of love and desire, enabling her to manipulate the feelings of others.
An extraordinarily skilled equestrian, sharing a deep, natural bond with pegasi (especially her pegasus, Pelorus).
Spoke fluent French naturally, as it is the official "language of love."

name: Thalia Grace
description: Thalia Grace is the daughter of Zeus, sister of Jason Grace. After several years as a pine tree on Half-Blood Hill, she got a new job leading the Hunters of Artemis.
skills: Ability to shoot and channel powerful bolts of lightning.
Great physical strength.
Precision with a bow and arrow, both of which improved after she joined the Huntresses of Artemis.
She can manipulate the Mist.

name: Travis Stoll
description: Travis Stoll is a Greek demigod son of Hermes and the former co-Head Counselor of Hermes' Cabin. He is currently attending college. Travis is Connor Stoll's brother.
skills: Possess the mystical ability to lock or unlock any type of door, safe, or constraint simply by touching it.
Can move in absolute silence and steal items from right under someone's nose without being noticed.
Exceptionally manipulative, clever, and experts at setting complex pranks or traps.

name: Will Solace
description: William "Will" Andrew Solace is a sixteen-year-old Greek demigod, the son of Apollo. He is a minor character in Percy Jackson and the Olympians and a recurring character in The Heroes of Olympus and The Trials of Apollo, and the deuteragonist of The Nico di Angelo Adventures. Will is the current head counselor of Apollo's Cabin and a prominent healer at Camp Half-Blood. He is openly bisexual and the boyfriend of Nico di Angelo.
skills: Advanced Healing
Sonic Whistle
He can emit a bright, warm light from his body, which he uses to illuminate dark spaces or blind opponents.
Elite Archery
Musicianship
